💬 Generative AI

Chatbot

In simple words

A program you can have a conversation with by typing or speaking.

A program you can have a conversation with by typing or speaking. Modern chatbots run on large language models; the first ones followed simple rules.

Example. ELIZA (1966) was one of the first chatbots. Today millions of people chat with AI assistants every day.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 4: Generative AI & Chatbots
  • Lesson 9: How Chatbots Write

Related words

  • Large language model (LLM)A huge neural network trained on enormous amounts of text to predict the next token.
  • PromptThe instruction or question you give to a generative AI.
  • Turing testAlan Turing's 1950 test: a machine passes if people chatting with it in text can't reliably tell it from a human.
  • HallucinationWhen an AI confidently gives an answer that sounds right but is false or made up.
  • Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)A way to make a chatbot more helpful: people rate its answers, and those ratings become its reward in reinforcement learning.
  • Reasoning modelA language model trained to work through a problem step by step before it gives its final answer.
